note: Desert state park campground in Red Rock Canyon off Hwy 14 near Cantil, with sites around one loop at the foot of the White House Cliffs. It fills on spring and fall weekends, so arrive by Thursday evening or Friday morning. Street-legal and green-sticker OHVs may use the park's dirt roads. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page + campground map PDF, ReserveCalifornia grid/details, OSM, imagery read. Open year-round, no closure in the banner. First-come only (no reservation system; RC lists 50 walk-in units, none web-bookable). $25 ($23 seniors), $6 extra vehicle. 50 sites (#7 walk-in), 30-ft max (agency-posted, so it stays), some pull-throughs; no hookups, pit toilets, potable water, a dump station, no showers. Not waterfront. Pin 482 m off on the visitor center - re-pin. Phone '' -> (661) 946-6092.
